d:
Are you planning to perform Pind Daan in Gaya? In this comprehensive travel guide and vlog, I share my personal experience of performing the sacred ritual at Gaya Ji. From arriving at the station to completing the final rituals at Vishnupad Temple, this video covers everything you need to know for a smooth and spiritual journey.
In this video, you will find:
Arrival & Logistics: How I reached Gaya and the cost of transport (Rickshaw/Auto).
Accommodation: Details on staying near the Vishnupad Temple and finding a safe hotel/ashram.
